correctness.rationale: The weighted Bergman monomial basis gives exact beta/gamma diagonal eigenvalues, and the gamma recurrence converts the commutator into a one-step weighted shift. The expansion of each weight is tau*n^(-1)*|1+b*exp(-i*tau*log n)|+O(n^(-2)). Since b<1/(1+tau), the limiting threshold map t-tau*|1+b*exp(-i(theta+tau*log t))| is strictly increasing on its possible root interval; outside the interval the sign is fixed. This gives a unique root and O(1) lattice counting discrepancy uniformly in the phase. Periodic harmonic averaging plus Ky Fan comparison yields the exact logarithmic singular trace. The included finite checker passed 450 diagnostics but is not used to infer infinite results.
